title: Keyed reputation lookups and LOL datasets (batch p2-G07-1: crowdsec_cti, abuseipdb, virustotal, hybrid_analysis, lol_datasets)

attributes.crowdsec: CrowdSec CTI smoke facts of an IP {reputation, confidence, background_noise, background_noise_score, behaviors, classifications, false_positives, attack_details, target_countries, scores, ip_range_24, ip_range_24_reputation, references, link}: provider data, internal use only (never exported outside the company)
attributes.abuseipdb: AbuseIPDB check facts of an IP {abuse_confidence_score, distinct_reporters, total_reports, last_reported_at, usage_type, isp, domain, country_code, is_tor, is_whitelisted, max_age_days} (no report comments): provider data, internal use only
attributes.abuseipdb_block: AbuseIPDB check-block summary of a range <= /24 {network, hosts, reported (addresses with reports, score, last report), max_score, max_age_days}: provider data, internal use only
attributes.virustotal: VirusTotal object facts {type, verdict, wording 'N/M engines flagged (last analysis <date>)', analysis counts, top_labels, reputation, votes, tags, categories, threat_label}: provider data, internal use only
attributes.vt_relationships: VirusTotal relationship pages read for the object {relationship: {read, filtered, count, more}}: one capped page each, cursors not followed
attributes.hybrid_analysis: Hybrid Analysis sandbox facts of a sample {verdict, threat_score, threat_level, av_detect, vx_family, environments, reports, analysis_start_time, tags} (never submitted file names): provider data, internal use only
attributes.loldrivers_hits: LOLDrivers catalogue entries the hash matches [{driver_id, name, category, verified, match (file or Authenticode hash kind), cves, techniques, link}]
attributes.lol_context: name and hash context from LOLBAS, HijackLibs and LOLRMM [{dataset, name, matched, categories, types, techniques, link}]: context only, never scored (file names collide; legitimate use is common)
attributes.export_restriction: the source's data may not be redistributed {source, redistributable: false, external_exports: 'verdict, link and source name only', verdict, link}: STIX/MISP/JSON exports shared outside the company carry only these

tags.lolbas: binary listed by the LOLBAS project (living-off-the-land binary or script): name match, context only
tags.hijacklibs: DLL listed by HijackLibs as a side-loading/search-order hijack candidate: name match, context only
tags.lolrmm: remote monitoring and management tool listed by LOLRMM: legitimate IT use is common, context only
tags.byovd: bring your own vulnerable driver: a known vulnerable kernel driver that attackers load to gain kernel access
tags.vulnerable_driver: kernel driver with known vulnerabilities (LOLDrivers 'vulnerable driver' category)
tags.malicious_driver: kernel driver catalogued as malicious (LOLDrivers 'malicious' category)
tags.bruteforce: the address was reported for credential brute-force attempts (SSH, RDP, web logins)
tags.exploit_attempt: the address was reported for exploitation attempts against public services
tags.crawler: the address was reported for crawling web content (aggressive or SEO crawling)
tags.dos: the address was reported for denial-of-service traffic
tags.backdoor: the address was reported for backdoor or web-shell activity

notes: Relations are the core vocabulary: uses_technique (ATT&CK ids of CrowdSec, Hybrid Analysis and LOLDrivers), attempted_exploit (CrowdSec CVEs: an attempt by the address, never has_vuln, so own-asset vulnerability rules such as CR15 never fire, P152 cond 6), communicates_with (sandbox-contacted hosts, VirusTotal contacted_*), contacted_by (VirusTotal communicating_files), resolves_to, hosted_domain and subdomain (VirusTotal relationships).
